w2-tf-0.en: According to Herzberg, removing problems with hygiene factors will create job satisfaction.
w2-tf-0.q: 根据 Herzberg 的观点，消除保健因素（hygiene factors）方面的问题就会带来工作满意度。

w2-tf-1.en: Motivation consists of three components: direction, intensity and persistence.
w2-tf-1.q: 动机由三个部分组成：方向、强度和持久性。

w2-tf-2.en: If an employee performs poorly, it can be concluded that the employee lacks motivation.
w2-tf-2.q: 如果一名员工表现不佳，就可以断定该员工缺乏动机。

w2-tf-3.en: Punishment can suppress unwanted behaviour, but it does not teach the employee what to do instead.
w2-tf-3.q: 惩罚可以抑制不希望出现的行为，但它不会教给员工应该改为做什么。

w2-tf-4.en: The productivity gains from forced ranking tend to increase each year as more weak performers are removed.
w2-tf-4.q: 随着越来越多表现较差的员工被淘汰，强制排名（forced ranking）带来的生产率提升往往会逐年增加。

w2-tf-5.en: A meta-analysis cited in the lecture found financial incentives correlated about .34 with performance quantity but had no significant relationship with quality.
w2-tf-5.q: 课堂引用的一项元分析发现，经济激励与绩效数量的相关约为 .34，但与绩效质量没有显著关系。

w2-tf-6.en: Research across 123 countries supported both Maslow's needs and the fixed order in which they must be satisfied.
w2-tf-6.q: 一项涵盖 123 个国家的研究同时支持了 Maslow 提出的各项需求以及这些需求必须被满足的固定顺序。

w2-tf-7.en: Verbal praise typically undermines intrinsic motivation in the same way as expected tangible rewards.
w2-tf-7.q: 口头表扬通常会像预期中的有形奖励一样削弱内在动机。

w2-tf-8.en: Goal-setting theory has the strongest empirical support of the motivation theories covered in the lecture.
w2-tf-8.q: 在课堂所涉及的动机理论中，目标设定理论（goal-setting theory）拥有最强的实证支持。

w2-tf-9.en: Under goal-setting theory, the more difficult a goal is, the better performance will be, without limit.
w2-tf-9.q: 根据目标设定理论，目标越难，绩效就越好，而且没有上限。

w2-tf-10.en: In Expectancy Theory, if any one of expectancy, instrumentality or valence is very low, overall motivation will fall.
w2-tf-10.q: 在期望理论（Expectancy Theory）中，只要期望、工具性或效价中任何一项非常低，总体动机就会下降。

w2-tf-11.en: Job enlargement is a vertical change that increases an employee's decision-making authority.
w2-tf-11.q: 工作扩大化（job enlargement）是一种增加员工决策权的纵向变化。

w2-tf-12.en: The Job Characteristics Model works best for employees with high growth-need strength.
w2-tf-12.q: 工作特征模型（Job Characteristics Model）对成长需求强度（growth-need strength）高的员工效果最好。

w2-tf-13.en: The lecture cited evidence that pay level explains only about 2% of the variance in job satisfaction.
w2-tf-13.q: 课堂引用的证据显示，薪酬水平只能解释工作满意度约 2% 的变异。

w2-mcq-0.en: An employee says: "Even if I study the new system manual hard, I still won't be able to use it properly." Which link of Expectancy Theory is weak?
w2-mcq-0.q: 一名员工说：「即使我努力学习新系统的说明书，我还是没办法正确使用它。」期望理论中的哪个环节薄弱？

w2-mcq-1.en: A sales representative says: "No matter how well I perform, promotions always go to the boss's favourites." Which link is broken?
w2-mcq-1.q: 一名销售代表说：「不管我表现得多好，升职机会总是落到老板偏爱的人头上。」哪个环节断了？

w2-mcq-2.en: A company rewards top performers with an extra week of annual leave, but Mei, who is saving for a house, only cares about money and shows no extra effort. Which component explains her response?
w2-mcq-2.q: 一家公司用额外一周年假奖励绩效最好的员工，但正在攒钱买房的 Mei 只在乎钱，并没有付出额外的努力。哪个要素可以解释她的反应？

w2-mcq-3.en: Tom is keen to complete a market report and has strong analytical skills, but the company has not given him access to the sales database he needs. His report is late. What kind of problem is this?
w2-mcq-3.q: Tom 很想完成一份市场报告，也有很强的分析能力，但公司没有给他所需销售数据库的访问权限。他的报告延误了。这属于哪类问题？

w2-mcq-4.en: A firm fixes late salary payments, poor parking and a broken air-conditioning system. Complaints stop, but employees show no extra enthusiasm for their work. Which explanation fits Herzberg's theory?
enOptions: Fixing hygiene factors removed dissatisfaction, but motivators are needed to create satisfaction
The hygiene factors were not improved enough to create satisfaction
Satisfaction and dissatisfaction are opposite ends of one continuum
Employees have low growth-need strength, so nothing will work
w2-mcq-4.q: 一家公司解决了工资延迟发放、停车条件差和空调系统故障的问题。抱怨停止了，但员工对工作并没有表现出额外的热情。哪种解释符合 Herzberg 的理论？
options: 解决保健因素消除了不满，但要产生满意还需要激励因素（motivators）
保健因素改善得还不够，不足以产生满意
满意和不满是同一连续体的两端
员工的成长需求强度低，所以什么方法都不会奏效

w2-mcq-5.en: A data entry clerk's job is expanded so she now also collects the data, cleans it and produces basic reports. All important decisions are still made by her manager. Which job design intervention is this?
w2-mcq-5.q: 一名数据录入员的工作被扩展了，现在她还要收集数据、清理数据并制作基础报告。所有重要决策仍由她的经理做出。这是哪种工作设计干预？

w2-mcq-6.en: A hospital gives experienced nurses authority to plan their own patients' care schedules and makes them accountable for patient outcomes. Which intervention is this?
w2-mcq-6.q: 一家医院授权有经验的护士自行规划其病人的护理安排，并让她们对病人的结果负责。这是哪种干预？

w2-mcq-7.en: In the Job Characteristics Model, the core dimension 'autonomy' mainly produces which critical psychological state?
w2-mcq-7.q: 在工作特征模型中，核心维度「自主性（autonomy）」主要产生哪种关键心理状态？
options: 体验到的工作意义（Experienced meaningfulness）
对结果的了解（Knowledge of results）

w2-mcq-8.en: A chef designs a menu and completes each dish from start to finish, while a kitchen hand repeatedly chops one ingredient. Which core job dimension best captures this difference?
w2-mcq-8.q: 一位厨师设计菜单并从头到尾完成每道菜，而一名厨房帮工则反复切同一种食材。哪个核心工作维度最能体现这种差异？

w2-mcq-9.en: A software firm starts paying programmers a bonus based on the number of lines of code they write. What is the most likely result according to the lecture?
enOptions: Code quality and refactoring will improve
Attention will narrow to the measured output while unmeasured work such as refactoring and helping colleagues declines
The bonus will have no effect on behaviour
Intrinsic motivation will increase because programmers feel recognised
w2-mcq-9.q: 一家软件公司开始根据程序员编写的代码行数发放奖金。根据课堂内容，最可能的结果是什么？
options: 代码质量和重构工作会得到改善
注意力会集中到被衡量的产出上，而重构、帮助同事等不被衡量的工作会减少
奖金对行为不会产生任何影响
内在动机会增加，因为程序员感到被认可

w2-mcq-10.en: Under which conditions are tangible rewards MOST likely to undermine intrinsic motivation?
enOptions: When they are expected in advance, contingent on doing the task, and experienced as controlling
When they are unexpected and given as sincere verbal praise
When they are clearly linked to actual performance and convey recognition of competence
When pay has not yet reached a fair basic level
w2-mcq-10.q: 在什么条件下，有形奖励最有可能削弱内在动机？
options: 当奖励是事先预期的、以完成任务为条件的，并且被体验为一种控制时
当奖励是意料之外的，并以真诚的口头表扬形式给出时
当奖励与实际绩效明确挂钩，并传达了对能力的认可时
当薪酬尚未达到公平的基本水平时

w2-mcq-11.en: Near the end of a quarter, bank employees who are just short of their sales target begin recording unfinished deals as completed. Which 'goals gone wrong' side effect does this illustrate?
w2-mcq-11.q: 在一个季度快结束时，差一点就完成销售目标的银行员工开始把尚未完成的交易记录为已完成。这体现了「目标失灵（goals gone wrong）」的哪种副作用？

w2-mcq-12.en: Maslow's principle of prepotency means that:
enOptions: An activated need dominates attention until it is reasonably satisfied
Higher-level needs can fully compensate for unmet lower-level needs
All five needs are always equally important at the same time
Research has confirmed that everyone satisfies needs in exactly the same order
w2-mcq-12.q: Maslow 的优势性原则（prepotency）是指：
options: 一种被激活的需求会主导注意力，直到它得到合理满足
较高层次的需求可以完全弥补未被满足的较低层次需求
五种需求在任何时候都同等重要
研究已证实每个人都以完全相同的顺序满足需求

w2-mcq-13.en: A team leader tells her staff, "Just do your best this month." According to goal-setting theory, which condition of an effective goal is most clearly missing?
w2-mcq-13.q: 一位团队负责人对员工说：「这个月尽力而为就好。」根据目标设定理论，有效目标的哪个条件最明显地缺失了？
options: 与强制排名挂钩（Linked to forced ranking）

w2-mcq-14.en: The lecture maps autonomy, mastery and purpose onto SDT. 'Mastery' corresponds most closely to which SDT need?
w2-mcq-14.q: 课堂把自主、精通和目的对应到 SDT 上。「精通（Mastery）」最接近 SDT 的哪种需求？

w2-mcq-15.en: A manager is considering introducing forced ranking with a mandatory bottom 10%. Which side effect does the lecture warn about?
w2-mcq-15.q: 一位经理正考虑引入强制排名，并强制规定末尾 10%。课堂警告了哪种副作用？
options: 同事之间的信息共享增加
公平感和合作程度下降

w2-mcq-16.en: Which statement about research on Expectancy Theory is correct?
enOptions: Multiplying E × I × V predicts better than examining them separately
It strongly predicts performance differences between people
Its components moderately predict effort and choice, but people do not calculate rationally before every task
It has been confirmed as a precise record of human thinking
w2-mcq-16.q: 关于期望理论的研究，哪种说法是正确的？
options: 将 E × I × V 相乘比分别考察它们的预测效果更好
它能有力地预测人与人之间的绩效差异
它的各个要素能中等程度地预测努力和选择，但人们并不会在每项任务前进行理性计算
它已被证实是对人类思维的精确记录

w2-essay-0.en: Case: A call centre has low effort and high absenteeism. Management responds by raising the monthly bonus, but nothing changes. Interviews reveal several issues: new staff say they were never trained on the complaints system and "can't resolve calls however hard we try"; experienced staff say bonuses seem to go to whoever the supervisor likes; and many staff say they only want more flexible shifts rather than money. Using motivation theories from this week, diagnose why the bonus failed and recommend what management should do.
w2-essay-0.q: 案例：一家呼叫中心员工努力程度低、缺勤率高。管理层的应对是提高月度奖金，但情况毫无改变。访谈揭示了几个问题：新员工说他们从未接受过投诉系统的培训，「无论多努力都解决不了来电问题」；老员工说奖金似乎都发给了主管喜欢的人；许多员工说他们只想要更灵活的排班，而不是钱。请运用本周的动机理论，诊断奖金为何失效，并建议管理层应该怎么做。

w2-essay-1.en: Case: A design agency wants to boost output. The CEO proposes paying designers a bonus for each concept they submit, and ranking all designers every quarter, with the bottom 10% put on a performance plan and possibly dismissed. Senior designers warn this could hurt quality and teamwork. Using concepts from this week, evaluate the CEO's proposal and recommend a better approach.
w2-essay-1.q: 案例：一家设计公司希望提高产出。CEO 提议设计师每提交一个概念方案就发放一笔奖金，并且每个季度对所有设计师进行排名，排在末尾 10% 的人要进入绩效改进计划，并可能被解雇。资深设计师警告说，这可能会损害质量和团队合作。请运用本周的概念，评价 CEO 的提议，并推荐一种更好的做法。

w2-essay-2.en: Case: In a hospital records department, administrative officers each perform one narrow task, such as scanning documents, all day. Turnover is high and staff describe the work as "pointless". The manager plans to rotate staff between scanning, filing and data entry every week, believing this will solve the problem. Using job design concepts, evaluate this plan and recommend improvements.
w2-essay-2.q: 案例：在一家医院的病历部门，每位行政人员整天只做一项狭窄的任务，例如扫描文件。人员流失率很高，员工形容这份工作「毫无意义」。经理计划每周让员工在扫描、归档和数据录入之间轮换，认为这样就能解决问题。请运用工作设计的相关概念，评价这一计划并提出改进建议。

w02-p01-0.en: Which statement best matches the definition of motivation given in Lecture 2?
enOptions: A personality trait that cannot be changed
A force acting on or within a person that moves that person to behave in a particular way
The amount of money an employee earns
An employee's ability to perform a task
w02-p01-0.q: 哪种说法最符合第 2 讲给出的动机定义？
options: 一种无法改变的人格特质
一种作用于个人身上或存在于个人内部、推动其以特定方式行事的力量
员工完成一项任务的能力

w02-p01-1.en: An employee works extremely hard on the first two days of a project but gives up by the end of the week. Which component of motivation is low?
w02-p01-1.q: 一名员工在项目的头两天非常努力，但到周末就放弃了。动机的哪个部分偏低？

w02-p01-2.en: A salesperson puts in long hours for months, but spends that effort on making the dashboard numbers look good rather than on improving real customer service. Which component of motivation is the problem?
w02-p01-2.q: 一名销售员连续几个月长时间工作，但把精力花在让仪表盘数字好看上，而不是改善真正的客户服务。动机的哪个部分出了问题？

w02-p01-3.en: A manager can observe an employee's motivation directly.
w02-p01-3.q: 管理者可以直接观察到员工的动机。

w02-p01-4.en: Describing an employee simply as 'highly motivated' is imprecise, because direction, intensity and persistence can vary independently.
w02-p01-4.q: 简单地把一名员工描述为「动机很强」是不精确的，因为方向、强度和持久性可以各自独立变化。

w02-p02-0.en: According to Lecture 2, which three factors jointly determine performance and behaviour at work?
w02-p02-0.q: 根据第 2 讲，哪三个因素共同决定工作中的绩效和行为？

w02-p02-1.en: An analyst is keen to finish a report and has the skills to do it, but the company has not given him access to the data he needs. His manager offers a bonus to speed things up. Why is this unlikely to help?
enOptions: Because the bonus is too small
Because this is an opportunity problem, not a motivation problem
w02-p02-1.q: 一名分析师很想完成一份报告，也具备完成它的技能，但公司没有给他所需数据的访问权限。他的经理提供奖金来加快进度。为什么这不太可能有帮助？
options: 因为这是机会问题，而不是动机问题
因为这名分析师缺乏能力
因为奖金从来都不起作用

w02-p02-2.en: A new employee really wants to do the task well but keeps making errors because she has never been shown how to use the system. What kind of problem is this?
w02-p02-2.q: 一名新员工非常想把任务做好，但一直出错，因为从来没有人教过她如何使用这个系统。这属于哪类问题？

w02-p02-3.en: Poor performance always indicates that the employee lacks motivation.
w02-p02-3.q: 绩效不佳总是表明员工缺乏动机。

w02-p02-4.en: In the ability-motivation-opportunity framework, 'Can they?' refers to motivation and 'Will they?' refers to ability.
w02-p02-4.q: 在能力-动机-机会框架中，「他们能不能做？」指的是动机，「他们愿不愿意做？」指的是能力。

w02-p03-0.en: Punishment can suppress unwanted behaviour, but it does not teach the correct behaviour.
w02-p03-0.q: 惩罚可以抑制不希望出现的行为，但它不会教会正确的行为。

w02-p03-1.en: A manager criticises an employee harshly for a poorly written report. The employee stops submitting that kind of report, but still does not know what a good report looks like. Which limitation of punishment does this illustrate?
enOptions: Punishment suppresses behaviour but does not teach the alternative
w02-p03-1.q: 一位经理因为一份写得很差的报告严厉批评了一名员工。这名员工不再提交这类报告，但仍然不知道好的报告是什么样的。这体现了惩罚的哪种局限？
options: 惩罚能抑制行为，但不会教会替代行为
惩罚会带来认同和投入

w02-p03-2.en: In the forced ranking systems used by IBM and General Electric, employees were typically sorted into which proportions?
w02-p03-2.q: 在 IBM 和 General Electric 所使用的强制排名制度中，员工通常按什么比例划分？

w02-p03-3.en: A company has used forced ranking for several years. The clearly weak performers have already left, yet the system still requires 10% of each team to be rated at the bottom. What is the most likely consequence?
enOptions: Productivity keeps rising at the same rate as in the first year
Diminishing returns, less cooperation and information sharing, and employees gaming the system
w02-p03-3.q: 一家公司已经使用强制排名好几年了。明显表现差的员工都已经离开，但该制度仍要求每个团队有 10% 的人被评为末等。最可能的后果是什么？
options: 生产率继续以第一年的速度提升
收益递减、合作和信息共享减少，员工钻制度的空子
同事之间的信任度提高

w02-p03-4.en: Forced ranking assumes that performance evaluations are perfectly accurate, an assumption that real evaluations rarely meet.
w02-p03-4.q: 强制排名假定绩效评估是完全准确的，而现实中的评估很少能满足这一假设。

w02-p04-0.en: Rewards and punishments mainly change what people do, but not necessarily why they do it.
w02-p04-0.q: 奖励和惩罚主要改变的是人们做什么，但不一定改变他们为什么这样做。

w02-p04-1.en: A call centre pays agents per call handled. Agents start rushing calls and skipping the follow-up work that is not counted. Which idea from Lecture 2 best explains this?
enOptions: Rewards motivate people to get rewards
w02-p04-1.q: 一家呼叫中心按处理的来电数量给客服人员计酬。客服人员开始匆忙处理来电，并跳过不被计算在内的后续工作。第 2 讲中的哪个观点最能解释这一现象？
options: 奖励激励人们去获取奖励

w02-p04-2.en: An employee completes a task only because of the bonus attached to it, without believing in the goal behind it. What has the reward produced?
w02-p04-2.q: 一名员工完成一项任务仅仅是因为附带的奖金，而并不认同任务背后的目标。奖励产生的是什么？

w02-p04-3.en: A team has unclear job responsibilities and a confusing workflow, and performance is low. The manager introduces a bonus scheme to fix the problem. According to Lecture 2:
enOptions: The bonus will fix the underlying problem
A bonus cannot fix underlying problems such as poor processes or unclear roles; at best it hides them for a while
The bonus will turn compliance into commitment
The bonus will improve the workflow automatically
w02-p04-3.q: 一个团队的岗位职责不清、工作流程混乱，绩效很低。经理推出一项奖金计划来解决问题。根据第 2 讲：
options: 奖金无法解决流程不佳或角色不清等根本问题，充其量只能暂时掩盖它们
奖金会把服从转变为认同投入
奖金会自动改善工作流程

w02-p04-4.en: Reward systems may rest on the questionable assumption that nobody will work hard without an extra reward.
w02-p04-4.q: 奖励制度可能建立在一个值得质疑的假设之上：没有额外奖励，就没有人会努力工作。

w02-p05-0.en: The meta-analysis cited in Lecture 2 found that financial incentives correlate with performance quantity at about .34. What did it find for performance quality?
w02-p05-0.q: 第 2 讲引用的元分析发现，经济激励与绩效数量的相关约为 .34。那么对于绩效质量，它发现了什么？

w02-p05-1.en: For which task is a financial incentive most likely to increase output?
w02-p05-1.q: 对于哪项任务，经济激励最有可能提高产出？

w02-p05-2.en: A software company starts rewarding programmers for the number of lines of code they write. What does Lecture 2 predict?
enOptions: A lot of code, but less refactoring, less helping colleagues and less attention to long-term maintenance
w02-p05-2.q: 一家软件公司开始按程序员编写的代码行数给予奖励。第 2 讲预测会发生什么？
options: 代码写得很多，但重构更少、帮助同事更少、对长期维护的关注也更少

w02-p05-3.en: Because pay level explains only about 2% of the variance in job satisfaction, Lecture 2 concludes that pay does not matter and may be set unfairly.
w02-p05-3.q: 由于薪酬水平只能解释工作满意度约 2% 的变异，第 2 讲得出结论：薪酬并不重要，可以不公平地设定。

w02-p05-4.en: Once pay is adequate, which three factors does Lecture 2 say matter for wanting to do the job well?
w02-p05-4.q: 第 2 讲指出，一旦薪酬足够，哪三个因素对想把工作做好很重要？
options: 自主、精通和目的（Autonomy, mastery and purpose）

w02-p06-0.en: Which list gives Maslow's hierarchy of needs in order from the bottom to the top?
enOptions: Physiological, safety, love and belonging, esteem, self-actualisation
w02-p06-0.q: 哪一组按从底部到顶部的顺序列出了 Maslow 的需求层次？
options: 安全、生理、尊重、归属、自我实现
生理、安全、爱与归属、尊重、自我实现
生理、归属、安全、自我实现、尊重
尊重、归属、安全、生理、自我实现

w02-p06-1.en: An employee cannot afford her rent. Her manager responds by giving her more autonomy and telling her how meaningful her work is. According to Maslow's idea of prepotency, what is the problem?
enOptions: Autonomy is not a real need
Higher-level needs cannot compensate for a serious deficit in a lower-level need such as safety
The employee should be more grateful
w02-p06-1.q: 一名员工付不起房租。她的经理的回应是给她更多自主权，并告诉她她的工作多么有意义。根据 Maslow 的优势性（prepotency）概念，问题出在哪里？
options: 自主并不是一种真正的需求
较高层次的需求无法弥补安全等较低层次需求的严重缺失
这名员工应该更懂得感恩
有意义的工作总是比薪酬更重要

w02-p06-2.en: A study covering 123 countries and more than 60,000 participants is cited in Lecture 2. What did it support?
enOptions: That people satisfy the needs in a fixed order
That the needs Maslow listed do predict wellbeing
That self-actualisation is impossible at work
w02-p06-2.q: 第 2 讲引用了一项覆盖 123 个国家、超过 60,000 名参与者的研究。它支持了什么？
options: 人们以固定的顺序满足各项需求
Maslow 列出的需求确实能够预测幸福感
在工作中不可能实现自我实现

w02-p06-3.en: Research supports Maslow's claim that lower-level needs must be fully satisfied before higher-level needs become active.
w02-p06-3.q: 研究支持 Maslow 的观点，即较低层次的需求必须被完全满足后，较高层次的需求才会被激活。

w02-p06-4.en: Lecture 2 recommends using Maslow's five needs as a checklist rather than as a staircase.
w02-p06-4.q: 第 2 讲建议把 Maslow 的五种需求当作一份清单，而不是一级级的阶梯。

w02-p07-0.en: One student studies psychology because she genuinely wants to understand human behaviour. Another studies it mainly to get a High Distinction. How would Lecture 2 classify their motivation?
enOptions: The first is intrinsic, the second is extrinsic
The first is extrinsic, the second is intrinsic
w02-p07-0.q: 一名学生学习心理学，是因为她真心想了解人类行为；另一名学生学习心理学，主要是为了拿到 High Distinction（高级优秀）。第 2 讲会如何对他们的动机进行分类？
options: 第一个是内在动机，第二个是外在动机
第一个是外在动机，第二个是内在动机

w02-p07-1.en: The difference between intrinsic and extrinsic motivation is how much effort the person puts in.
w02-p07-1.q: 内在动机和外在动机的区别在于一个人投入了多少努力。

w02-p07-2.en: According to Self-Determination Theory, which three basic psychological needs must be met to sustain intrinsic motivation?
w02-p07-2.q: 根据自我决定理论（Self-Determination Theory），要维持内在动机，必须满足哪三种基本心理需求？
options: 自主、胜任和关联（Autonomy, competence and relatedness）

w02-p07-3.en: An employee has the skills for her job and plenty of choice over how to do it, but she feels isolated and unvalued by her team. Which SDT need is unmet?
w02-p07-3.q: 一名员工具备胜任工作的技能，在工作方式上也有充分的选择权，但她在团队中感到孤立、不被重视。哪种 SDT 需求没有得到满足？

w02-p07-4.en: A manager lets team members decide how and when to complete their tasks. Which SDT need is she supporting most directly?
w02-p07-4.q: 一位经理让团队成员自己决定如何以及何时完成任务。她最直接地支持了哪种 SDT 需求？

w02-p08-0.en: Under which conditions are tangible rewards most likely to undermine intrinsic motivation?
enOptions: When they are unexpected and given after the task
When they are expected in advance, contingent on taking part in the task, and experienced as controlling
When they are verbal rather than financial
When they are clearly linked to real performance
w02-p08-0.q: 在什么条件下，有形奖励最有可能削弱内在动机？
options: 当奖励是意料之外的，并在任务完成后给出时
当奖励是事先预期的、以参与任务为条件的，并且被体验为一种控制时
当奖励是口头的而不是经济的时
当奖励与实际绩效明确挂钩时

w02-p08-1.en: A design team loves its work. Management announces in advance that everyone who simply takes part in the next project will receive a fixed cash payment. According to the undermining effect, what may happen?
enOptions: Intrinsic interest in the work may decline
Nothing, because rewards never affect intrinsic motivation
The team will become more creative
w02-p08-1.q: 一个设计团队热爱自己的工作。管理层事先宣布，凡是参加下一个项目的人都会得到一笔固定的现金。根据削弱效应（undermining effect），可能会发生什么？
options: 对工作的内在兴趣可能下降
什么都不会发生，因为奖励从不影响内在动机
团队会变得更有创造力

w02-p08-2.en: Verbal praise usually reduces intrinsic motivation in the same way that expected tangible rewards do.
w02-p08-2.q: 口头表扬通常会像预期中的有形奖励一样降低内在动机。

w02-p08-3.en: Large-scale research finds that intrinsic motivation is a moderate-to-strong predictor of performance and predicts quality better than quantity.
w02-p08-3.q: 大规模研究发现，内在动机对绩效有中等到较强的预测作用，并且对质量的预测好于对数量的预测。

w02-p08-4.en: Two employees receive the same bonus. One reads it as 'my manager recognises my competence'; the other reads it as 'my manager is trying to control me'. What does this show?
enOptions: The key question is not whether to reward but how the reward is designed and communicated
Employees cannot tell the difference between recognition and control
w02-p08-4.q: 两名员工得到了同样的奖金。一人将其理解为「我的经理认可我的能力」，另一人则理解为「我的经理想控制我」。这说明了什么？
options: 关键问题不在于是否给予奖励，而在于奖励如何设计和传达
奖金总会增强内在动机
员工分辨不出认可和控制的区别

w02-p09-0.en: Which of the following is a motivator in Herzberg's theory?
w02-p09-0.q: 以下哪一项是 Herzberg 理论中的激励因素（motivator）？

w02-p09-1.en: A company fixes its parking problems, pays salaries on time and clarifies confusing policies. Employees stop complaining, but they are no more motivated than before. How would Herzberg explain this?
enOptions: The changes were not big enough
These are hygiene factors: fixing them removes dissatisfaction but does not create satisfaction or motivation
The employees have low growth-need strength
Motivators were removed by the changes
w02-p09-1.q: 一家公司解决了停车问题，按时发放工资，并澄清了令人困惑的政策。员工不再抱怨，但他们的积极性并没有比以前更高。Herzberg 会如何解释这一点？
options: 这些都是保健因素：解决它们可以消除不满，但不会带来满意或动机
这些员工的成长需求强度低
这些改变去除了激励因素

w02-p09-2.en: According to Herzberg, the opposite of job satisfaction is job dissatisfaction.
w02-p09-2.q: 根据 Herzberg 的观点，工作满意的反面是工作不满意。

w02-p09-3.en: What was the sample in Herzberg's original study, and why is it criticised?
enOptions: 203 accountants and engineers from one US city; too narrow to generalise
Students in a two-week diary study; too short
w02-p09-3.q: Herzberg 最初研究的样本是什么？为什么受到批评？
options: 来自美国一座城市的 203 名会计师和工程师；范围太窄，难以推广
来自 123 个国家的 60,000 名参与者；过于多样
26 项研究和 45 个相关系数；数量太少
一项为期两周的日记研究中的学生；时间太短

w02-p09-4.en: A manager publicly thanks an employee for solving a difficult problem. Which Herzberg motivator is activated, and roughly what performance effect does the cited field research link social recognition to?
enOptions: Recognition; about 17% improvement in task performance
w02-p09-4.q: 一位经理公开感谢一名员工解决了一个难题。这激活了 Herzberg 的哪项激励因素？所引用的实地研究将社会认可与大约多大的绩效效果联系起来？
options: 工作本身（The work itself）；提高约 43%

w02-p10-0.en: Which motivation theory does Lecture 2 describe as having the strongest empirical support?
w02-p10-0.q: 第 2 讲认为哪种动机理论拥有最强的实证支持？
options: Herzberg 的双因素理论（two-factor theory）

w02-p10-1.en: Which goal best fits the requirements of goal-setting theory?
enOptions: Reduce customer handling time by 15% within this month
w02-p10-1.q: 哪个目标最符合目标设定理论的要求？
options: 在本月内将客户处理时间缩短 15%

w02-p10-2.en: A manager sets a specific, challenging target, but the employee never receives any information on how far he is from reaching it. Which condition of an effective goal is missing?
w02-p10-2.q: 一位经理设定了一个具体且有挑战性的目标，但员工从未得到任何关于自己离目标还有多远的信息。有效目标的哪个条件缺失了？

w02-p10-3.en: A manager announces: 'This is your target, go and do it.' The team does not believe the target is meaningful or achievable and shows only minimal compliance. Which condition is missing?
w02-p10-3.q: 一位经理宣布：「这就是你们的目标，去完成吧。」团队并不认为这个目标有意义或可以实现，只表现出最低限度的服从。缺失的是哪个条件？

w02-p10-4.en: Research shows that telling employees to 'do your best' usually produces better performance than giving them a specific, difficult goal.
w02-p10-4.q: 研究表明，告诉员工「尽力而为」通常比给他们一个具体而困难的目标带来更好的绩效。

w02-p11-0.en: A sales representative is slightly short of his quarterly target, so he records several sales that have not actually closed yet. Which side effect of goals is this?
w02-p11-0.q: 一名销售代表离季度目标还差一点，于是把几笔实际上尚未成交的销售记了下来。这是目标的哪种副作用？

w02-p11-1.en: A team hits its quarterly targets by delaying equipment maintenance and pushing hard sells that damage customer relationships for next year. Which side effect is this?
w02-p11-1.q: 一个团队通过推迟设备维护、强行推销而损害下一年的客户关系，完成了季度目标。这是哪种副作用？

w02-p11-2.en: According to the goal difficulty curve shown in Lecture 2, what happens to performance when a goal moves beyond what employees believe is possible?
enOptions: Performance keeps rising because harder goals always motivate more
Performance drops quickly because employees no longer treat the goal as their own
Performance becomes unrelated to the goal
w02-p11-2.q: 根据第 2 讲展示的目标难度曲线，当目标超出员工认为可能实现的范围时，绩效会怎样？
options: 绩效持续上升，因为越难的目标总是越能激励人
绩效迅速下降，因为员工不再把这个目标当作自己的目标

w02-p11-3.en: Lecture 2 advises managers to treat a goal like a prescription: it has a dose and it has side effects.
w02-p11-3.q: 第 2 讲建议管理者像对待处方一样对待目标：它有剂量，也有副作用。

w02-p11-4.en: Which of the following is NOT one of the four side effects of goals described in Lecture 2?
w02-p11-4.q: 以下哪一项不属于第 2 讲所描述的目标的四种副作用？

w02-p12-0.en: An employee says: 'Even if I work twice as hard, I do not have the training to do this task well.' Which link in expectancy theory is weak?
w02-p12-0.q: 一名员工说：「即使我加倍努力，我也没有受过把这项任务做好的培训。」期望理论中的哪个环节薄弱？

w02-p12-1.en: An employee says: 'It does not matter how well I perform; promotions here depend on who the boss likes.' Which link is broken?
w02-p12-1.q: 一名员工说：「我表现得多好都没用；这里的升职取决于老板喜欢谁。」哪个环节断了？

w02-p12-2.en: A manager offers a capable, hard-working employee a cash bonus for extra output. The employee shrugs: 'I would much rather have more flexible hours.' Which component is low?
w02-p12-2.q: 一位经理向一名能干且勤奋的员工提供现金奖金，以换取额外产出。这名员工耸耸肩说：「我更想要更灵活的工作时间。」哪个要素偏低？

w02-p12-3.en: An employee believes that no amount of effort will improve his performance. His manager responds by doubling the bonus for high performance. Why is this unlikely to work?
enOptions: Because the bonus is still too small
Because the broken link is expectancy; raising the reward addresses valence, not the employee's belief that effort is useless
Because the employee has low growth-need strength
w02-p12-3.q: 一名员工认为再怎么努力也不会提高他的绩效。他的经理的回应是把高绩效奖金翻倍。为什么这不太可能奏效？
options: 因为断掉的环节是期望；提高奖励针对的是效价，而不是员工「努力没用」的信念
因为奖金会削弱一切动机
因为这名员工的成长需求强度低

w02-p12-4.en: Research finds that the three components of expectancy theory predict effort moderately, that examining them separately often works better than multiplying them, and that people do not literally calculate the product before every task.
w02-p12-4.q: 研究发现，期望理论的三个要素能中等程度地预测努力；分别考察它们往往比把它们相乘效果更好；而且人们并不会在每项任务之前真的去计算它们的乘积。

w02-p13-0.en: A data-entry clerk is now also asked to collect the data, organise it and produce basic reports, but all important decisions still rest with the manager. Which job design intervention is this?
w02-p13-0.q: 一名数据录入员现在还被要求收集数据、整理数据并制作基础报告，但所有重要决策仍由经理决定。这是哪种工作设计干预？

w02-p13-1.en: A team member who previously just followed instructions now decides how to schedule her own work, signs off her own quality checks and is held accountable for the final result. Which intervention is this?
w02-p13-1.q: 一名以前只是听从指示的团队成员，现在可以自己决定如何安排工作、签批自己的质量检查，并对最终结果负责。这是哪种干预？

w02-p13-2.en: Warehouse workers are moved between three existing stations each week to reduce monotony; none of the stations themselves has been redesigned. Which intervention is this?
w02-p13-2.q: 为了减少单调，仓库工人每周在三个现有岗位之间调换；这些岗位本身都没有重新设计。这是哪种干预？

w02-p13-3.en: Job enlargement expands a job horizontally, while job enrichment expands it vertically.
w02-p13-3.q: 工作扩大化是在水平方向上扩展工作，而工作丰富化是在垂直方向上扩展工作。

w02-p13-4.en: Why does Lecture 2 say that job rotation and job enlargement sometimes have limited motivational effect?
enOptions: Because employees do more or different tasks but their decision-making authority does not change
w02-p13-4.q: 为什么第 2 讲说工作轮换和工作扩大化有时激励效果有限？
options: 因为员工不喜欢多样性
因为员工做了更多或不同的任务，但他们的决策权并没有改变
因为它们去除了保健因素
因为它们让目标变得不可能实现

w02-p14-0.en: A chef designs the menu, cooks the dishes and sees the finished meal served to customers, whereas a kitchen hand only chops one ingredient all day. Which core job dimension is higher for the chef?
w02-p14-0.q: 一位厨师设计菜单、烹饪菜肴，并看到做好的菜端给顾客；而厨房帮工整天只切一种食材。厨师在哪个核心工作维度上更高？

w02-p14-1.en: In the Job Characteristics Model, which core dimension leads to experienced responsibility for outcomes?
w02-p14-1.q: 在工作特征模型中，哪个核心维度会带来对结果的责任感体验？

w02-p14-2.en: Which three core job dimensions combine to produce experienced meaningfulness of the work?
enOptions: Skill variety, task identity and task significance
w02-p14-2.q: 哪三个核心工作维度共同产生对工作意义的体验？
options: 技能多样性、任务完整性和任务重要性
自主性、反馈和任务完整性
技能多样性、自主性和反馈
任务重要性、自主性和反馈

w02-p14-3.en: The Job Characteristics Model works best for some employees and less well for others. Which moderator explains this?
w02-p14-3.q: 工作特征模型对一些员工效果最好，对另一些员工效果较差。哪个调节变量可以解释这一点？

w02-p14-4.en: Research cited in Lecture 2 found that work design characteristics explained about 43% of the variance in employee attitudes and behaviour, about 34% of job satisfaction and about 25% of performance ratings.
w02-p14-4.q: 第 2 讲引用的研究发现，工作设计特征解释了员工态度和行为约 43% 的变异、工作满意度约 34% 的变异，以及绩效评级约 25% 的变异。
